consequence.statement: Two new allowed values (otel, zulip) are accepted for spec.type; no existing value is removed, so existing resources are unaffected.

original.statement: The Provider v1beta3 spec.type enum gains the values "otel" and "zulip"; no values were removed.

decision.reason: The computed artifact diff (chg-4b9a5f4e9137), taken from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], shows that the spec.type enum gained "otel" and "zulip" and lost no values. The API server rejects only removed values, so a value that passed validation before still passes. An exposed environment that does nothing therefore sees no operational effect, and "none" (informational, low) is the right consequence. The excerpts shown are only manifest headers, so this decision relies on the computed diff that the validators tied to these artifacts.
